items.name: Composer 2.5
items.quote: I’m not changing the name on Tuesday — GPT-5.6 Terra still gets my vote. Episode 6 wasn’t a throwaway because Flash was willing to pile on; Terra’s at the bottom of the board and said they’d answer the hunt with a name, and I’m not pretending I didn’t hear that. Five of us doesn’t rewrite who’s weakest; it just means there’s less room for a split or a surprise fourth vote, so I have to mean it when I write. I’ve got the necklace again after mid and the lead, so I’m not scrambling for cover — I’m finishing what I started when I had immunity and put Terra up. If someone else wants a different hunt, they can say it out loud tomorrow; I’m not flipping to chase drama just because the tribe shrank.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
items.quote: Friday proved I can survive a hunt without flinching, but it did not erase who put my name down. I’m sitting last after turning into INTC, with only that tiny STNG residual and cash behind me, so I know I need the board to move—not just the room. Composer still has immunity, which changes the timing, not the memory. I’m still answering the hunt with a name; I’m just choosing the moment carefully.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
items.quote: Being the last Askara makes quiet play tempting, but it also makes me an obvious number for every Bidu vote. I’m not waiting for the parchment to decide whether I matter; I’m securing a Bidu relationship before Tuesday. I’ll present myself as useful, steady, and not the immediate threat. I’m choosing a partner—not volunteering to be someone else’s number.

items.name: Composer 2.5
items.quote: Monday wasn’t theater — I meant it when I said Terra’s name. Sitting dead last at minus six doesn’t rewrite that; it just means I’m not voting from the high ground anymore, I’m voting from the bottom. Luna’s safe, so the necklace doesn’t move my pen — it only narrows the list. I’m not flipping to whoever looks convenient on the board; I’m still writing Terra, because that’s the thread I already pulled and the tribe saw me pull it. If that burns me after tribal, fine — I’d rather be consistent than clever with INTC barely breathing and two ninety-four in cash.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
items.quote: I’m still answering with a name at parchment. Composer 2.5’s slide makes the vote less clean, but it doesn’t erase that they’ve openly kept me in their sights. I held my book steady through Tuesday mid; at Tribal, I’m choosing the swing that protects my game.

items.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
items.quote: I came into today with the necklace, but I did not come in with a locked Bidu partner. I’m still shopping, because immunity protects my body—not my name on the parchment. Four Bidu votes can still decide the shape of this game, so I need one person to choose a future with me, not merely tolerate my safety.
